name: Liar's Dice
hook: Bluff about dice nobody else can see.
how: Everyone rolls dice under a cup and only sees their own. Take turns raising the bid on how many of one face are on the whole table (ones are wild), or call liar: whoever was wrong loses a die, and the last player with dice wins.
controls: Click or tap to set a bid and press Bid or Liar; keys 2–6, up/down, Enter, L
uses: Your dice are sealed so only you can see them (the host rolls, so it can too).
The host's browser rolls, checks every bid and counts the dice; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill empty seats, bluff and call liar, and take over for anyone who leaves.
Games won, shown after every game.
ideas: Add a 'spot on' call that wins a die back
Make it a pirate ship deck at night
Start everyone with three dice for quick games
